tasks.title: Lecture #56
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in an architecture class.
tasks.transcript:
W: The Eastgate Center in Harare, Zimbabwe, is a mixing complex combining retail spaces and offices. When the architect Mick Pierce was asked to design the building in the early 1990s, he faced a big challenge. How to keep all its shops and offices cool without traditional air conditioning and do it during an economic crisis.
Energy costs were high, and importing advanced air conditioners was impossible.
To solve this dilemma Pierce looked to termite mounds. Termites are insects that live in large colonies. They build big mounds on the ground throughout the African savannah. The mounds are amazing structures, summarize 3 m above ground and extend another one to 3 m below the ground. The underground chambers connect to the above-ground chimneys through a maze of tunnels, and this entire system works like natural climate control. Warm air rises and escapes through the top, while cooler air flows in from below. The thick walls of soil and clay absorb heat during the day and release it at night. Termites fine tune airflow by opening and closing vents, adding or removing soil to enlarge or seal passages. On hot days, they open more vents for cooling. At night, they close them to keep warm.
Thin Pierce borrowed these ideas. The Eastgate Center's walls are made from thick materials like concrete and brick, and there's a system of ducts and adjustable louvers throughout the building to mimic those vents. The result, a building that uses far less energy than its conventional counterparts.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: A type of architecture that combines modern needs with traditional styles
options.B: A building project designed to protect local plant and animal life
options.C: The use of natural materials in modern construction
options.D: A design solution inspired by nature

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这次谈话的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：To solve this dilemma Pierce looked to termite mounds. ... Thin Pierce borrowed these ideas. The Eastgate Center's walls are made from thick materials... and there's a system of ducts and adjustable louvers throughout the building to mimic those vents. 选项分析： A. 一种将现代需求与传统风格相结合的建筑类型。演讲者虽然提到了建筑的功能是零售和办公（现代需求），但并未讨论其风格是否传统，核心是设计灵感来源，因此A选项错误。 B. 一个旨在保护当地动植物的建筑项目。演讲者完全没有提及该项目与保护动植物有关，因此B选项错误。 C. 在现代建筑中使用自然材料。演讲者提到了使用混凝土和砖等材料，但重点在于这些材料的厚度及其功能，以及整个通风系统是如何模仿自然的，并非泛泛讨论使用自然材料，因此C选项错误。 D. 一个受自然启发的设计解决方案。演讲者从建筑师面临的挑战出发，详细描述了他如何研究白蚁丘并获得灵感，最终应用到建筑设计中，整篇谈话都在围绕这一受自然启发的解决方案展开，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: What is the Eastgate Centre built to house?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：Eastgate Centre是用来容纳什么的？ 定位原文：The Eastgate Center in Harare, Zimbabwe, is a mixing complex combining retail spaces and offices. 选项分析： A. 一个研究中心。原文并未提及研究中心，因此A选项错误。 B. 一个能源生产设施。原文并未提及能源生产，因此B选项错误。 C. 一个空调工厂。原文提到无法进口空调，但并未说该建筑是生产空调的工厂，因此C选项错误。 D. 办公室和商店。原文明确说该综合体结合了零售空间（retail spaces）和办公室（offices），因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: What was the architect's main challenge when designing the Eastgate Centre?

options.A: Designing a tall structure using only brick and concrete
options.B: Avoiding the need for conventional air conditioning
options.C: Convincing governmental officials to support his project
options.D: Creating a structure that could survive in a harsh environment

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：建筑师在设计Eastgate Centre时面临的主要挑战是什么？ 定位原文：How to keep all its shops and offices cool without traditional air conditioning and do it during an economic crisis. 选项分析： A. 仅用砖和混凝土设计一个高层建筑。原文提到建筑使用了砖和混凝土，但并未说这是挑战，也没有强调高度，因此A选项错误。 B. 避免使用传统空调的需求。原文明确提出了核心问题：如何在不使用传统空调的情况下为所有空间降温，这正是建筑师面临的主要挑战，因此B选项正确。 C. 说服政府官员支持他的项目。原文完全没有提及与政府官员沟通的内容，因此C选项错误。 D. 创造一个能在恶劣环境中生存的结构。原文虽然提到经济危机，但挑战的核心在于解决降温问题，而非建筑本身的生存能力，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply about vents in the termite mounds?

options.A: They are located primarily below ground level.
options.B: They help to protect the termites from predators.
options.C: They are much larger than termites' bodies.
options.D: Termites use them to actively control the airflow in the mounds.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：关于白蚁丘中的通风口，说话者暗示了什么？ 定位原文：Termites fine tune airflow by opening and closing vents, adding or removing soil to enlarge or seal passages. On hot days, they open more vents for cooling. At night, they close them to keep warm. 选项分析： A. 它们主要位于地面以下。原文提到整个系统包括地下 chambers 和地上 chimneys，通风口并非主要位于地下，因此A选项错误。 B. 它们有助于保护白蚁免受捕食者侵害。原文完全没有提及通风口与防御捕食者有关，而是强调其调节温度的功能，因此B选项错误。 C. 它们比白蚁的身体大得多。原文并未比较通风口和白蚁身体的大小，因此C选项错误。 D. 白蚁利用它们主动控制蚁丘内的气流。原文详细描述了白蚁如何通过打开、关闭通风口以及调整通道大小来微调气流，这正暗示了它们是主动控制气流的，因此D选项正确。
